name: Felice Bonetto
features: weathered lined face, greying hair, heavy brows, thickset build, buccaneering grin
bio: Il Pirata — the pirate. A hard, fearless veteran who drove for Alfa Romeo, Maserati and Lancia and never gave a yard. Third at Monza in 1951 in the Alfetta. Killed leading the Carrera Panamericana in 1953 when his Lancia hit a lamppost in a Mexican village at speed.
